title: 第一卷 第27章 灵山宗的人来了
content_zh:
秦绝摇头道：“府里用不了这么多丫鬟，你若想让小青、小荷轻松一些，那就留下两个。其他的，都安排到缺人手的地方去。这个年纪的小丫头，脑子转得快，培养起来容易，心思也单纯些。”

    韩汐笑道：“好，今日先让她们休息一下，明日我再安排。”

    秦绝道：“迟几日也无妨，先让她们吃上几顿饱饭。”

    “少爷仁心。”韩汐俏眸里，闪过一道亮光。

    “奴婢谢过少爷。”一群丫头，齐齐眼泪汪汪的跪下，朝着秦绝磕头。

    秦绝淡漠道：“都起来吧。进了秦府，以后你们就是我秦家的人。只要你们安分守己，便没人可以再欺负你们。

    带她们去吧。”

    “嗯，你们随我走吧。”韩汐应了一声，带着少女们离开。

    次日。

    秦绝将洪铁虎叫到跟前。

    洪铁虎换上了一身秦家配备的新衣，人看上去也精神了些。

    “见过少爷。”洪铁虎中规中矩的作礼。

    秦绝淡淡道：“手伸出来。”

    洪铁虎眼眸一颤，伸出了右手。

    秦绝左手抓住洪铁虎的手掌，右手则是顺着洪铁虎的手腕，一直摸到肩头。

    “呵，这周家，手段够狠的，整条右臂的经脉，全都断裂了。”秦绝眯眼道。

    洪铁虎沉声道：“是的，属下这两条手臂，都被周家的绝学裂脉爪废了，右脚是被剑尖刺穿挑断。”

    秦绝右手一张，掌心里出现一个白色丹药瓶，以及一个黑色小坛子。

    他将其中的黑色小坛子，递给洪铁虎：“这坛子里，装得是蛟神膏，有接筋续脉之效。你回去之后，在伤处早晚各抹上一次。这丹药瓶里的是生元强血丹，一日一颗。外敷内服，差不多七日，你便可恢复。”

    洪铁虎眼眸震颤，这蛟神膏他听说过，极为珍贵。

    这一小坛，至少价值二十万灵石！更重要的，此物乃是稀缺之物，寻常人即便有灵石，也未必能有路子可以买到！

    至于生元强血丹，他没有听说过，但想必也是不便宜。

    洪铁虎深吸一口气，没有拒绝，只是颤抖的伸出双手，将小坛子、丹药瓶，揽入怀中抱紧，生怕手里拿不稳，路上摔碎了。

    “多谢少爷！”洪铁虎眼里闪烁了泪光道。

    唯有伤势痊愈，他将来才有机会报仇！
content_en:
Qin Jue shook his head and said: "The house doesn't need so many maids. If you want to make it easier for Xiao Qing and Xiao He, just leave two. The rest will be assigned to places where there is a shortage of manpower. Little girls of this age have fast brains, are easy to train, and have simple thoughts."

    Han tide smiled and said: "Okay, let them have a rest today, and I will make arrangements tomorrow."

    Qin Jue said: "It doesn't matter if it's a few days later. Let them have a few full meals first."

    "Young Master is kind-hearted." A bright light flashed in Han tide's pretty eyes.

    "I thank you, young master." A group of girls all knelt down with tears in their eyes and kowtowed to Qin Jue.

    Qin Jue said indifferently: "Everyone, get up. After entering the Qin Mansion, you will be members of my Qin family from now on. As long as you stay safe and keep yourselves, no one can bully you anymore.

    Take them with you. "

    "Well, you can come with me." Han tide responded and left with the girls.

    The next day.

    Qin Jue called Hong Tiehu to him.

    Hong Tiehu put on new clothes equipped by the Qin family and looked more energetic.

    "I've met the young master." Hong Tiehu bowed politely.

    Qin Jue said calmly: "Stretch out your hand."

    Hong Tiehu's eyes trembled and he stretched out his right hand.

    Qin Jue grabbed Hong Tiehu's palm with his left hand, and his right hand followed Hong Tiehu's wrist to his shoulder.

    "Oh, this Zhou family's methods are so cruel that the entire meridians in the right arm were broken." Qin Jue said with narrowed eyes.

    Hong Tiehu said in a deep voice: "Yes, both of my arms were crippled by the Zhou family's unique skill, the Vein Splitting Claw, and my right foot was pierced and severed by the tip of the sword."

    Qin Jue opened his right hand, and a white pill bottle and a small black jar appeared in his palm.

    He handed the small black jar to Hong Tiehu: "This jar is filled with dragon ointment, which has the effect of connecting tendons and renewing veins. After you go back, apply it to the injured area in the morning and evening. The pill bottle contains the vitality and strong blood pill, one pill a day. Apply it externally or internally, and you will be able to recover in about seven days."

    Hong Tiehu's eyes trembled. He had heard that this dragon ointment was extremely precious.

    This small altar is worth at least two hundred thousand spiritual stones! More importantly, this item is a rare item. Even if ordinary people have spiritual stones, they may not be able to buy it!

    As for the Shengyuan Strong Blood Pill, he had never heard of it, but it must not be cheap.

    Hong Tiehu took a deep breath and did not refuse. He just stretched out his hands tremblingly, took the small jar and the elixir bottle into his arms and held them tightly, for fear that he would not be able to hold them firmly and break them on the road.

    "Thank you, Master!" Hong Tiehu said with tears in his eyes.

    Only by recovering from his injuries will he have a chance to take revenge in the future!
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 27 The people from Lingshan Sect are here
